channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: CRYMACHINA
item.description: CRYMACHINA is an action RPG where mechanical girls strive to survive in a post-apocalyptic world to become “Real Humans''. But what does it mean to be a “Real Human”?

item.title: Days Gone - Broken Road DLC
item.description: Fight to survive in the definitive Days Gone experience. Face off against hordes of Freakers in the harsh reality of the Farewell Wilderness.

item.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27
item.description: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.

item.title: Gently Packed
item.description: Step into the shoes of a cashier in Gently Packed, a relaxing store management game where you scan, pack, and serve customers with care. Upgrade your shop, run promotions, meet corporate goals, and pay off your franchise loan.

item.title: Grand Theft Timeline
item.description: 1-4+ players time-travel kidnapping-collection dungeon-crawling heist with physics, guns, bosses, arena, homebase, skins, and stocks! Kidnap people across 200+ worlds of history & fiction, haul them home in cages and farm paradox in your garage. 25+ theme packs, 2,000+ NPCs and Workshop mods!

item.title: HELLDIVERS™ Dive Harder Edition
item.description: HELLDIVERS™ is a hardcore, cooperative, twin stick shooter. As part of the elite unit called the HELLDIVERS, players must work together to protect SUPER EARTH and defeat the enemies of mankind in an intense intergalactic war.

item.title: IT THINKS! - Build Your Own GPU
item.description: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

item.title: Lost Soul Aside™
item.description: Embark on an epic odyssey to save your younger sister – and the whole of humanity – from mysterious dimensional invaders from beyond the starlit skies in Lost Soul Aside™.

item.title: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls
item.description: Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter.

item.title: Sackboy™: A Big Adventure
item.description: PERFECTLY CRAFTED FOR PC. PlayStation® icon Sackboy bursts into action on PC in a huge 3D multiplayer platforming adventure. An epic journey stuffed with platforming challenges. Deeply immersive controls. Collaborative, chaotic and joyful multiplayer fun.

item.title: STAR WARS Zero Company™
item.description: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in STAR WARS Zero Company™, a single-player turn-based tactics game set in the twilight of the Clone Wars™.

item.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails into Reverie
item.description: Three different legends are about to unfold! Determine the fates of Rean Schwarzer, Lloyd Bannings, and the mysterious “C” in this climactic chapter of The Legend of Heroes series.

item.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel III
item.description: Experience an epic story developed across three titles, and crafted for new and old fans alike. Also includes an interactive introduction to catch up new players to the ongoing story so anyone can dive right in to the world of Trails of Cold Steel.

item.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel IV
item.description: The long awaited finale to the epic engulfing a continent comes to a head in the final chapter of the Trails of Cold Steel saga!

item.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak
item.description: The spriggan known as Van Arkride, an underground professional, accepts any job, acting as detective, negotiator, or bounty hunter. Dive into the Trails series' latest chapter with intense combat, beautiful visuals, and a new alignment system in Calvard!

item.title: Ys IX: Monstrum Nox
item.description: While imprisoned in Balduq, Adol is cursed and becomes a Monstrum. With his newfound powers, he must stop the Grimwald Nox from consuming the city.

item.title: Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of DANA
item.description: Ys returns with a brand new adventure for the first time in 8 years! Adol awakens shipwrecked and stranded on a cursed island. There, he and the other shipwrecked passengers he rescues form a village to challenge fearsome beasts and mysterious ruins on the isolated island.

item.title: Ys X: Proud Nordics
item.description: Experience the definitive edition of Adol and Karja's unforgettable journey across Obelia Gulf in Ys X: Proud Nordics!

item.title: Crackheads
item.description: Explore the marvelous world of Crackheads alone or with up to 50 players. Team up, turn on your friends, make money, build your empire, scavenge trash for questionable meals, and stay high through all of it.

item.title: Granule
item.description: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.

item.title: PARANORMASIGHT: The Seven Mysteries of Honjo
item.description: How far would you go to bring someone back from the dead? Discover the depths that some will go to in this horror-adventure game.

item.title: Pool of Madness
item.description: A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals. Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

item.title: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
item.description: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.
